caseName: Smith v. Delta Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Dennis SMITH v. DELTA AIR LINES, INC.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of Fifth Third Bancorp v. Dudenhoeffer,573 U.S. ---- (2014).
